subject: Marketplace listing evidence window, support SLA slots, and brand phrasing clarification
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-partner@aws.amazon.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence window and support SLA slots for Acme Health listing

Hi Diego,

Thanks for submitting the initial listing package for Acme Health. Before we can progress to the publish queue we need two clarifications from Redwood: 

1) Evidence window: We require a single consolidated evidence PDF that maps each claim in the listing (pricing, SLA, uptime, data residency) to the specific artifact (SOC 2 Type II, KMS architecture diagram, hosting diagram). Can you provide that by EOD Tuesday 9/19?

2) Support SLA guardrails: Marketplace requires the published support hours and escalation route. You listed "24/7 support" in the draft. Please confirm the actual on-call model and provide the regional primary support windows (US/EU/APAC). If 24/7 is not full engineering on-call, we need the exact wording (e.g., "24/7 support via ticketing with 8x5 phone escalation in US").

Also, minor copy check: product description includes the phrase "low-latency superior reliability" — marketplace copy guidelines prefer avoiding comparative superlatives that imply third-party ranking. Recommend rewording to "low-latency, production-ready inference".

Can you confirm timelines? If Tuesday is tight we can accept Wednesday 9/20 but need advance notice.

Thanks,
Jamal
AWS Marketplace Operations

Attachment: marketplace-evidence-schema-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence window and support SLA slots for Acme Health listing

Marissa / Laura — forwarding ops' ask below. Two asks: consolidated evidence PDF + exact support phrasing and regional hours. Jamal gave us until 9/19 (or 9/20 with notice).

Quick notes:
- Marissa: can you own the evidence mapping? I put together the first pass of artifacts (SOC2 report, KMS diagram, Hosting region table) — see attached folder link.
- Laura: can you confirm the support phrasing? For Acme we intended: 24/7 monitoring, ticketing with on-call engineer in US (8x5 phone escalation), EU phone escalation M-F 9-5 CET, APAC support via ticketing with next-business-day phone escalation. If Jamal will not accept partial 24/7 wording we may need to update listing copy.

I'll draft the consolidated PDF once you confirm mapping + phrasing. Deadline: aim EOD 9/18 internal so we can iterate.

Thanks — Diego
Account Exec, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-evidence-index.csv

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence window and support SLA slots for Acme Health listing

Diego/Laura — I pulled the artifacts and started a mapping doc. High-level:
- SOC 2 Type II (report): maps to "security and controls" claim.
- KMS architecture diagram: maps to "data encryption at rest" and key management claim.
- Hosting region breakdown (GCP us-east1 / AWS us-east-2): maps to "data residency" claim.
- Support runbook excerpt: maps to "support SLA" claim.

Questions for Laura: can we commit to the following published support wording?
"Redwood Inference provides 24/7 ticketing support with an on-call engineering team available for critical incidents. Phone escalation is available in the US (8:00–18:00 PT) and EU (9:00–17:00 CET) on business days; APAC customers receive priority ticket routing with next-business-day phone escalation."

This preserves our actual on-call structure while keeping the listing customer-facing and honest. If Ops (Jamal) thinks the wording still implies a 24/7 phone line we should change "on-call engineering team available for critical incidents" to "on-call engineering team for critical incidents (response times may vary by region)".

I will assemble the consolidated PDF tonight and include a one-line mapping table per claim.

—Marissa
Senior Partnerships Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com, marketplace-partner@aws.amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence window and support SLA slots for Acme Health listing

Hi Jamal — thanks for the clear list. Attached is the consolidated evidence package and our proposed support wording (see attachments). Highlights:

- Evidence PDF: "redwood_acme_marketplace_evidence_package_v1.pdf" includes a one-line mapping for each claim and the corresponding artifact (SOC 2 summary, KMS diagram page 3, hosting regions table page 4, support runbook excerpt page 6).
- Support wording we propose to publish:
  "Redwood Inference provides 24/7 ticketing support. An on-call engineering team is available for critical incident response; phone escalation is provided in the US (08:00–18:00 PT) and EU (09:00–17:00 CET) on business days. APAC customers receive priority ticket routing and next-business-day phone escalation."

We also adjusted product copy to remove comparative language; "low-latency, production-ready inference" replaces the previous phrase.

If you need any artifact re-scoped (e.g., a redacted SOC 2 excerpt or a signed architecture attestation) tell us which page and we will produce it by EOD 9/19.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachments: redwood_acme_marketplace_evidence_package_v1.pdf; support-coverage-windows.csv

From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-partner@aws.amazon.com
Date: Tue, 20 Sep 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence window and support SLA slots for Acme Health listing

Diego,

Thanks — received the consolidated package and the revised copy. The evidence mapping looks good. Two small follow-ups: 

1) SOC 2 excerpt: please replace the raw SOC 2 PDF with a redacted PDF that removes customer names and internal IP addresses (we can accept a redacted excerpt with a notarized cover page).
2) Product description: the revised phrase "low-latency, production-ready inference" is acceptable.

Once we get the redacted SOC 2 excerpt we will schedule the listing for the next publish queue (estimated 72 hours). Please reply here when the redacted file is uploaded.

Best,
Jamal
AWS Marketplace Operations

Attachment: marketplace-publish-checklist.pdf (stub)
